papers.title: SEGA: Spectral-Energy Guided Attention for Resolution Extrapolation in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) have emerged as a dominant architecture for text-to-image generation, yet their performance drops when generating at resolutions beyond their training range.

papers.title: Forecasting Scientific Progress with Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in scientific discovery, yet whether it can anticipate scientific progress remains unclear. We introduce CUSP benchmark.

papers.title: Unsupervised Process Reward Models
papers.abstract: Process Reward Models (PRMs) are a powerful mechanism for steering large language model reasoning by providing fine-grained, step-level supervision without human annotations.

papers.title: AutoRubric-T2I: Robust Rule-Based Reward Model for Text-to-Image Alignment
papers.abstract: Aligning Text-to-Image (T2I) generation models with human preferences using automatically synthesized rubrics for VLM judges.

papers.title: Forecasting Downstream Performance of LLMs With Proxy Metrics
papers.abstract: Progress in language model development is driven by comparative decisions. We propose proxy metrics by aggregating token-level statistics for reliable performance forecasts.

papers.title: Efficient Agentic Reasoning Through Self-Regulated Simulative Planning
papers.abstract: How should an agent decide when and how to plan? We propose SR2AM decomposing decision-making into simulative reasoning, self-regulation, and reactive execution.

papers.title: LoREnc: Low-Rank Encryption for Securing Foundation Models and LoRA Adapters
papers.abstract: Foundation models and low-rank adapters enable efficient on-device generative AI but raise risks. LoREnc is a training-free framework securing FMs via spectral truncation.

papers.title: Rule2DRC: Benchmarking LLM Agents for DRC Script Synthesis with Execution-Guided Test Generation
papers.abstract: Translating natural language design rules into correct DRC scripts is labor-intensive. Rule2DRC is a large-scale benchmark with 1,000 rule-to-script tasks.

papers.title: OmniPro: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Omni-Proactive Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Omni-proactive streaming video understanding is an emerging capability. OmniPro is the first benchmark to jointly evaluate omni-modal perception and proactive responding.

papers.title: "I didn't Make the Micro Decisions": Measuring, Inducing, and Exposing Goal-Level AI Contributions in Collaboration
papers.abstract: As LLMs increasingly shape how users form goals, attributing contributions in human-AI collaboration becomes critical. CoTrace decomposes explicit goals into verifiable requirements.
